_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The command palette offers exact recording actions and starts audio by click and screen by Enter. The test seeded a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "open the recording palette", every time a step says so: press_key "k" with modifier "Control", wait for the command palette input (".command-palette-input") to be visible, and fill it with "Record audio" (all three, every time). "The palette item X" is the command palette item whose title is exactly X; select it with '.command-palette-item[data-test-title="X"]' (the page keeps that attribute equal to the item's title, so "Record audio" does not match "Record audio and screen"). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible.
2. Open the recording palette.
3. The palette item "Record audio" should be visible, and its ".command-palette-item-shortcut" should have the text exactly "Ctrl+Shift+M" (assert_text on '.command-palette-item[data-test-title="Record audio"] .command-palette-item-shortcut').
4. The palette item "Record audio and screen" should be visible, and its ".command-palette-item-shortcut" should have the text exactly "Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M".
5. Click the palette item "Record audio".
6. The recording panel should get data-mode "microphone", and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should become 1.
7. Click the cancel button. No recording panel should remain (count 0).
8. Open the recording palette again, then fill its input with "audio and screen".
9. The palette item "Record audio and screen" should be visible and have the class "selected".
10. Press Enter (the palette input has focus; do not click anything).
11. The recording panel should get data-mode "screen" and [data-testid="recording-preview"] should be visible.
12. Eval "(m => ({display: m.displayRequests, synchronousDisplay: m.synchronousDisplayRequests, microphone: m.microphoneRequests, starts: m.recorderStarts}))(window.__recordingMock)" should become exactly {"display":1,"synchronousDisplay":1,"microphone":2,"starts":2}.
13. Open the recording palette again. There must be no palette item "Record audio" and no palette item "Record audio and screen" (both counts 0).
14. Press Escape, then click the cancel button.

steps.expression: (m => JSON.stringify({display: m.displayRequests, synchronousDisplay: m.synchronousDisplayRequests, microphone: m.microphoneRequests, starts: m.recorderStarts}))(window.__recordingMock)
